relevance_note: Single case report of a man with Tangier disease and an ABCA1 variant: "Genetic testing showed a homozygous variant in the ABCA1-gene".
method_note: Hand extraction of a one-patient image case (accepted manuscript; no tables). The Markdown encodes '>' and '<' as '>' and '<'; spans keep the Markdown text, while variant values and severity values decode them to the printed characters ('c.5785G>T'). Variant type and pathogenicity are not stated by the authors, so left 'not reported' (missense not derived from HGVS). 'atherosclerosis' is stated without site, so both coronary and non-coronary checklist items are 'not reported'. Intestinal mucosal lipid deposits marked observed from foam cells/foamy histiocytes in colonic mucosa (lipid content is not stated explicitly). Tonsillectomy recorded as medical history (checklist item observed), not as a treatment. Total cholesterol 80 mg/dL lies inside the paper's stated normal range (< 190 mg/dl) and is not recorded as a feature; LDL is not reported. No contradictions found.
